risk_if_not_implemented: Without Continue Essential Mission & Business Functions, security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), Reduced Operational Productivity (R-BC-3), Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Continue Essential Mission & Business Functions (BCD-08.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
